untouched_raw_rule: No structure-proof requirement for preserving intact whole raw originals. No flag becomes a semantic/factual/rights/admission pass. Known SHA review holds additive; no automatic sourcewide extrapolation.
automatic_hold_meaning: Reason-coded source-role/representation REVIEW HOLD, not major-corruption/bad-English assertion. Catalogue descriptions can be coherent; they are distinct from substantive textbook chapter exposition.

rules.catalog: At least two complete anchored licence->format field cycles, with no obvious complete main-prose sentence before the first cycle; repeated structural metadata not topic/wordcount. Catalog descriptions may be coherent. Example/credit discussions remain documented false-positive risk.
rules.linked_index: All nonempty lines following one initial title line are explicitly Primary/Secondary Source URL records. Any explanatory paragraph prevents automatic flag.
rules.flattened_code: // physical line contains class declaration, static method and statement; source-newline loss is suspected, no program correction or blanket code ban.
rules.missing_operands: Unqualified (and)/(or)/( and ) are context-only. Only explicit both-surfaces spaced missing labels flag, plus empty math wrappers, standalone For the relation/function/equation/matrix/expression immediately followed by labelled subquestion, announced estimated-to-be-about value followed by However/Therefore/Thus, and measured/given/calculated/defined quantity ending dangling and. No symbols guessed. These are review holds, not semantic truth proofs.
rules.media: A figure/media reference alone is context-only. Missing REQUIRED dependency must be established source-specifically or through verified native dependency graph, never by reference count.
rules.component_tails: Raw glossary/reference/attribution headings diagnostic only; no auto cropping. Exact native/projection/independent boundary proof gates transformations; whole authored lead/section/chapter only, all components+credits+inverse preserved.

evaluation: Report all30 AND existing-languagepass-conditioned confusion/precision/recall. Language labels are exact30indexed queries against independently verified frozen token metadata, no inference rerun. Generic recall is explicitly incomplete; exact known holds do not validate generalization. No sourcewide quality/yield extrapolation.
bound: 30units/1,090,911B source text, max803,253B actual;1MB receipt cap/unit;16MB aggregate incl2MB terminalslots;55/60s1GB. No parser package/tokenizer/inference/network.
uncertainty: Rules intentionally miss silent missing quotations/formulae and factual/rights/source-version errors. Exact known holds remain. Do not represent generic unflagged corpus as usable.
runtime_observations: Actual bounded30 runner will report supervisor tree peak RSS, output bytes, max diagnostic events/unit and max receipt bytes. No actual retained-source policy execution has occurred during preparation.
